stem: What can the reader conclude about the dog from this sentence?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 12.

_I followed, keeping my distance so as not to scare the calf._

options.label: F
options.text: He is no longer interested in getting on the boat with Lewis.

options.label: G
options.text: He is not certain of where Lewis wants to explore next.

options.label: H
options.text: He has a new understanding of the calf's feelings.

options.label: J
options.text: He is no longer frightened by the calf.

visual_elements:
I followed, keeping my distance
so as not to scare the calf.
